summary.text: A mixed LGA with its headquarters at Oguma. Its three main peoples are the Bassa-Komo (the largest), the Bassa-Nge and the Ebira Koto. Igala live here too.

peoples.name: Bassa-Komo
peoples.note: The largest of the three main peoples. Wikipedia dates their arrival to about the 1830s.

peoples.name: Bassa-Nge
peoples.note: Wikipedia dates their arrival to about the 1850s.

languageUse.text: Bassa speakers often also speak Igala, Ebira or Nupe.
